title: Malicious code in @lymmhere/lymmexc (npm)
description: The npm package @lymmhere/lymmexc contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of control potentially granted to attackers, complete remediation cannot be guaranteed by removal alone.
